description.value: Qaya Way West Transportation, a Homalco First Nation-owned operator based in Campbell River, runs two scheduled water taxi routes through the Discovery Islands: a southern run to Savary Island (Mon 10am / Fri 5pm, June 26–September 7, 2026) and a year-round northern run through the Discovery Islands and mainland inlets (Mon 9am / Fri 12pm, plus a seasonal Wednesday sailing). The online booking form asks whether you're bringing bikes or kayaks, so bikes are clearly accepted, but no fee or size limit is published — call ahead to confirm.
